summary: The missing native column width dialog now consumes actual table manager and Sfx command ownership, and both sizing families guard original document identity.
findings: Source GetMaxColWidth retains immediate-neighbor MINLAY arithmetic and single-column GetRight semantics. Draft resets on visible column changes and Apply reinitializes live separators before uint16 ingress.

Actual frame tests cover cursor/history and ODT, cancellation, CM/INCH, first/middle/last widths and document replacement during submit propagation. Browser controls match source grid order and alignment with ordinary menu/ODT flows at1280/390.

Fresh100 coverage for all three sizing owners; current Writer view combines fresh changed counters only with exact-source historical counters. No threshold reductions, no parity/default promotion and no save/open/recovery changes.
residual_risks: Complete native weld and Help service behavior, web-document preference profile, protected/deleted/nested/vertical/RTL table model parity remain unverified; provenance retains bounded unverified status.
